verdicts.reason: Both break the key motif: the shoe is pulled off the lime circle, leaving the circle as a meaningless blob cropped at the bottom-right, and both set 'Full review inside.' nearly as large as the headline, so the headline loses its dominance. A at least keeps a clean centred logo and headline stack. Its flaws are the NEW VIDEO badge stranded on the orphaned circle far from the headline, and a shoe floating in dead space. B is worse at the top: the badge is jammed into the top-left corner against the edge, and the logo is squeezed beside it at the right edge, so they compete as two focal points.
